name: task_manager
title: Tasks
description: Tasks as a channel: every task its principal asked, owns, is assigned or reported is a thread, every change and comment on it a message, and a message sent into the thread is a comment on the task. One driver, two kinds of row: the local person's (user:local, created automatically) and a Chief of Staff agent's, which is woken here when its staff finish, fail, ask or stall.

principal.label: Principal
principal.hint: Whose tasks this channel carries — the local person (user:local) or an agent (agent:<id>, set when Chief of Staff mode is turned on).
